source.omitted_tests: All other backend tests, live external-API tests, Redis/Postgres integration, blocking-I/O tests and frontend tests.

archive.hash_meaning: Measured official commit-addressed archive; not an independently authenticated publisher signature.

grader_source.scope: Official unchanged scorer unit tests with upstream synthetic completions/targets. No dataset access, native eval task, solver or model execution.
grader_source.test_runtime_difference: Recipe lock installs Inspect AI 0.3.271; the Inspect Evals source uv.lock carries Inspect AI 0.3.263. The full upstream lock was not synced. Test runner direct package versions come from its unchanged dev group and uv.lock; the recipe runtime lock remains unchanged.

environment.isolation: Installation/tests/installed-help/dependency observations use a new private prefix, fresh HOME/XDG/cache/test state and an explicit child environment without credential/provider variables. Source/version/release preflights use the installed native tools.
environment.upstream_version_difference: DeerFlow CI pins uv 0.11.1 / Python 3.12; this bounded host run uses installed uv 0.12.17 / Python 3.13.15, within backend requires-python >=3.12.

research.discovery: Available skill/tool descriptions and existing DeerFlow research/pins reviewed; retained the user-selected source rather than authoring a runtime. No new skill or global client configuration installed.
research.capability_claim_depth: Actual native dependency installation and selected unchanged upstream unit tests; no full server, workflow or model acceptance.
research.install_basis: DeerFlow backend/Makefile uv sync --locked; Inspect Evals GAIA README pip install; existing recipe expands its unchanged wheel hash lock through Python venv/pip.

independent_observation.distinction: Archive comparison and installed distribution/hash inspection are local structural observations; the two pytest runs remain unchanged upstream unit tests.

retained_failures.condition: Same selected native pytest command before backend dependency installation; no pytest module.
retained_failures.resolution: Supported uv sync --locked --python 3.13; identical test command later passed.
retained_failures.proves: Missing runtime/test prerequisite is detected. This is not an executed failing upstream test.

retained_failures.condition: Same selected native pytest command before dev test-runner installation; no pytest module.
retained_failures.resolution: Native uv pip install of upstream dev runner versions from its uv.lock; identical test command later passed.
retained_failures.proves: Missing test prerequisite is detected. This is not an executed failing scorer test.

retained_failures.condition: langgraph-sdk 0.4.2 metadata requires websockets>=14,<16; the upstream override installs 16.0.
retained_failures.resolution: Preserved without changing upstream source/dependencies. Upstream pyproject explains the explicit compatibility override; selected unit tests pass, but the metadata checker failure remains.

evidence_boundaries: Upstream backend tests include native upstream mocks; conftest pre-mocks the subagent executor. Passing them does not establish subagent/model execution.
Official scorer tests use upstream synthetic completions and wrong-answer cases; they establish scorer behavior, not a GAIA dataset score.
No full DeerFlow server, Docker/image lifecycle, MCP process connection, native skill discovery through a running worker, model invocation, gated dataset fetch or provider usage measurement.
No claim of measured superiority, token savings, another-host portability, global installation or production readiness.
Raw records retain the actual returned rtk command streams and exit codes. Public output is sanitized/projection; it is not a new test replay.

output_retention.private_records: Original returned command output, argument vectors, working directories, start/end timestamps and exit codes retained outside the checkout in the owned qualification prefix.
public_sanitization: Private prefix and repository absolute paths replaced with placeholders.
ANSI color escapes removed if present.
Long install/help/release-note output projected as explicitly marked; raw byte counts and SHA256 bind the retained complete streams.
No credentials, private preexisting account state, host paths, native session/run identifiers or conversations published.
output_retention.cleanup: Owned dependency/source prefixes retained for rollback and review; no background service was started.
